policy: Reuse only repository-owned, provenance-verified official footage. Preserve source identity, create a target-scene derivative identity, require fresh byte-bound system visual QA, and keep each visual content identity at no more than two non-contiguous uses.

reuses.editorial_note: Verified deep-sea biodiversity footage supplies dark deep-ocean physical context only; maps and evidence retain all location and nodule claims.
Verified scientists deploying an ROV from a research vessel provide real marine field-operation scale without claiming the depicted vessel is Chikyu.
Official NOAA ROV operations provide direct scientific observation context for deep-seabed tracks; cited evidence retains the measured persistence claim.
Official expedition field-assessment operations provide real survey and decision context without identifying the vessel as Chikyu or a commercial mining ship.
Official NOAA water-column footage supplies real ocean depth and darkness for the closing physical metaphor; it introduces no new location or quantitative claim.
